definitions.explanation: Glasses used to correct age-related farsightedness (presbyopia). Typically used by people in their 40s and older who have difficulty reading small text up close.

examples.japanese: {老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Lately I can't read the newspaper without reading glasses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四十代|よんじゅうだい}→四十代：24046_yonjuudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。

notes:
Glasses specifically designed to correct ⟦{老眼|ろうがん}→老眼：06369_rougan⟧ (presbyopia), the age-related difficulty in focusing on nearby objects.

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{老眼|ろうがん}→老眼：06369_rougan⟧ (presbyopia) + {鏡|きょう} (lens/glasses).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put on reading glasses
- {老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off reading glasses
- {老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to start needing reading glasses

ALTERNATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
Some people avoid {老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう} because the character {老|ろう} (old) feels blunt. Softer alternatives include:
- リーディング⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧: "reading glasses" (loanword)
- {手元用|てもとよう}メガネ: glasses for close-up use

RELATED WORDS:
- メガネ / ⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧: glasses (general)
- ⟦{遠近両用|えんきんりょうよう}→遠近両用：30036_enkinryouyou⟧メガネ: bifocal/progressive glasses
